description: Header file defining template class and specific implementations for various dimensional Instance Normalization modules in PyTorch's C++ API, including class declarations, method signatures, and documentation comments.

classes.name: InstanceNormImpl
classes.description: Template base class for dimension-specific instance normalization modules, providing core functionality for applying normalization, handling batched and unbatched inputs, and pretty printing.

classes.name: InstanceNorm1dImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for 1D instance normalization, inherits from InstanceNormImpl with D=1.

classes.name: InstanceNorm2dImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for 2D instance normalization, inherits from InstanceNormImpl with D=2.

classes.name: InstanceNorm3dImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for 3D instance normalization, inherits from InstanceNormImpl with D=3.

methods.name: apply_instance_norm
methods.description: Applies instance normalization to the input tensor using stored running statistics, weights, and biases.

methods.name: handle_no_batch_input
methods.description: Handles input tensors without batch dimension by unsqueezing and squeezing.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs the forward pass, applying normalization and handling batched/unbatched inputs.

methods.name: _check_input_dim
methods.description: Checks the input tensor's dimensions for the specific normalization module.

methods.name: pretty_print
methods.description: Outputs a formatted description of the module's configuration.
